transforms.title: Transforms
transforms.description: Run fixed batch-cleaning jobs or built-in deterministic transforms.

jobs.title: Basic clean
jobs.description: Create an asynchronous cleaning job from one dataset. The fixed, reproducible result is published as a new canonical dataset.
jobs.inputHint: Enter a dataset name or exact version. Custom operators and parameters are not exposed yet.
jobs.resultRefHint: Created when the job completes; an existing name is never overwritten.
jobs.identityConflict: This dataset already has the same basic-clean job under another result name. Use the existing result shown in Recent jobs; one cleaning job cannot currently bind a second result name.
jobs.noResultRef: Historical job without a result name
jobs.unchanged: No data change; input version reused
jobs.resultRefConflict: The dataset was produced, but the result name currently points to {{version}} and was not overwritten.

pipeline.title: Fixed cleaning pipeline
pipeline.description: Every basic-clean job runs these operators in order; operators and parameters are fixed.

whitespace.title: Normalize whitespace
whitespace.detail: Normalizes whitespace in temporary decision text without rewriting the published record.

length.title: Filter by length
length.detail: Retains text with at least 40 characters after normalization (min_len = 40).

deduplicate.title: Exact deduplication
deduplicate.detail: Removes exact full-text duplicates with case preserved (lowercase = false).

pipeline.publication: Operators select retained records only. Databench then publishes the original records as a canonical dataset and creates the result name entered above.

transforms.identityPreserve: Output records keep their existing record IDs.
transforms.identityDerive: Output records receive new record IDs.
transforms.inputsHint: Input order affects the transform result.
transforms.inputRoleHint: Enter a dataset name or version ID.
transforms.inputPlaceholder: Enter a dataset name or version ID
transforms.paramsHint: Enter a JSON object. Available fields depend on the selected transform.
transforms.paramsObject: Parameters must be a JSON object.
transforms.noParamsBody: This transform always uses an empty {} parameter object.
transforms.expectedHint: When updating an existing name, enter its current version to prevent overwriting another update.
transforms.expectedNeedsRef: Enter a result name before specifying its current version.
transforms.messageNeedsRef: Enter a result name before adding a version note.
transforms.newRef: This is a new name and will be created when the transform finishes.
transforms.refLookupFailed: The current version for this result name could not be read.

append-evidence.title: Append evaluation evidence
append-evidence.description: Append new ratings, rewards, verdicts, or preference relations to existing records.
append-evidence.inputRequirement: 2 datasets: base dataset + evidence patch dataset
append-evidence.outputResult: Keeps record IDs and only appends new evidence; other records remain unchanged.
append-evidence.paramsNote: No parameters; new evidence comes from the second input dataset.

base.label: Base dataset
base.hint: The complete dataset containing the original records.

patch.label: Evidence patch dataset
patch.hint: Record IDs must match the base dataset and may only append candidate signals or preference relations.

prompt-rewrite.title: Rewrite prompt content
prompt-rewrite.description: Replace shared content, tools, or verification config for prompt-only records.
prompt-rewrite.outputResult: Creates new IDs for rewritten records and records their exact parent lineage.
prompt-rewrite.paramsNote: No parameters; rewritten content comes from the second input dataset.

base.label: Base dataset
base.hint: Contains the prompt-only records to rewrite.

rewrite.label: Rewrite dataset
rewrite.hint: Uses matching record IDs and only changes content, tools, or verification config.

sample.title: Deterministic random sample
sample.description: Select a fixed number of records from one dataset using a reproducible random seed.
sample.outputResult: Creates a sampled dataset without changing record content or record IDs.
sample.paramsNote: count is the number of records; seed makes the sample reproducible.

base.label: Base dataset
base.hint: Choose the dataset name or version ID to sample.

selection-update.title: Update candidate selection
selection-update.description: Apply selected-state and rank updates to existing candidates from a patch.
selection-update.inputRequirement: 2 datasets: base dataset + selection patch dataset
selection-update.outputResult: Keeps record and candidate IDs and only updates selected and rank.
selection-update.paramsNote: No parameters; selection updates come from the second input dataset.

base.label: Base dataset
base.hint: The complete dataset containing the candidates to update.

patch.label: Selection patch dataset
patch.hint: Records and candidates must match the base dataset and may only change selected or rank.

subset.title: Create a subset by record ID
subset.description: Keep only specified records without changing their content or record IDs.
subset.outputResult: Creates a new dataset containing only the specified records.
subset.paramsNote: Record IDs must be unique and sorted in ASCII order.

base.label: Base dataset
base.hint: The complete dataset containing the records to filter.

lineage.title: Dataset lineage
lineage.graphLabel: Lineage relationships between dataset versions and the jobs that created them
